name: MonarchPageTree
title: PageTree
summary: The pages of a multi-page document in named groups, with running page numbers; read only it is navigation, with editing handlers it organises pages and groups.
whenToUse: In the side pane or a sheet of a multi-page document, handbook or course, to move between its pages and, for editors, to reorder, add, rename and delete pages and groups.
whenNotToUse: For a folder hierarchy of any depth, use MonarchTreeView. For the headings inside one page, use the page outline. For app navigation, use the navigation bar or rail.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPageTree(groups: List<MonarchPageTreeGroup>, selected: String?, onSelect: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, numbered: Boolean = true, enabled: Boolean = true, scrollState: ScrollState = rememberScrollState(), labels: MonarchPageTreeLabels = MonarchPageTreeLabels(), onReorder: ((groups: List<MonarchPageTreeGroup>, move: MonarchPageTreeMove) -> Unit)? = null, onAddPage: ((groupId: String) -> Unit)? = null, onAddGroup: ((label: String) -> Unit)? = null, onRenameGroup: ((groupId: String, label: String) -> Unit)? = null, onDeleteGroup: ((groupId: String) -> Unit)? = null, onDeletePage: ((pageId: String) -> Unit)? = null, addIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, menuIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchPageTreeGroup(id: String, label: String, pages: List<MonarchPageTreePage>)
class MonarchPageTreeMove(kind: MonarchPageTreeMoveKind, id: String, fromGroupId: String?, toGroupId: String?, toIndex: Int)

class MonarchPageTreeLabels(label, untitled, number, noPages, addPage, addPageText, addFirstPage, addGroup, groupActions, pageActions, more, renameGroup, moveGroupUp, moveGroupDown, deleteGroup, moveTo, deletePage, addGroupTitle, groupName, newGroupName, renameSubmit, cancel, deleteGroupTitle, deleteGroupConsequence, typeToConfirm, deletePageTitle, cannotUndo, groupMoved, pageMovedTo, reorderableList), every parameter optional

options.name: groups
options.description: The groups and their pages, in order.

options.name: selected
options.description: The id of the open page: the selected row, with the accent fill and bar.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with a page's id when it is chosen. The app navigates.

options.name: numbered
options.description: Shows page numbers (01, 02, …) running across groups, in the locale's digits.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether pages can be chosen and edited. Disabled uses the disabled text role.

options.name: scrollState
options.description: The scroll state of the tree, which scrolls itself.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the drag reorder strings.

options.name: onReorder
options.description: Makes the order editable: drag and the handle's actions within a group, "Move to" another group from a page's menu, Move group up and down from a group's menu. Receives the new groups and what moved.

options.name: onAddPage
options.description: Shows an add button on each group heading and "Add first page" under an empty group. Receives the group id; the app adds the page.

options.name: onAddGroup
options.description: Shows "Add group" at the end, which asks for a name in an alert dialog. Receives the trimmed name.

options.name: onRenameGroup
options.description: Shows "Rename group" in the group menu, which asks for the new name. Called only when the name changed.

options.name: onDeleteGroup
options.description: Shows "Delete group" while there is more than one group, behind a confirmation that asks for the group's name when it has pages.

options.name: onDeletePage
options.description: Shows "Delete page" in the page menu while there is more than one page, behind a confirmation.

options.name: addIcon
options.description: The icon of the heading add buttons, such as a plus MonarchIcon; without it they show "Add page". Their TalkBack name is "Add page to <group>" either way.

options.name: menuIcon
options.description: The icon of the menu buttons, such as a more MonarchIcon; without it they show "More". Their TalkBack name is "Actions for <name>" either way.

states.name: navigation
states.description: Without handlers: the groups as headings and the pages as rows; the open page is the selected row.

states.name: editing
states.description: With onReorder, each group's pages are a MonarchReorderableList with a drag handle per row, and the headings show the page count and a menu.

states.name: empty group
states.description: "No pages yet." in the subtle role under the heading, or "Add first page" with onAddPage.

states.name: dialog
states.description: An alert dialog asks for a name (rename, add) or confirms a delete; the confirm button stays disabled until the input is valid.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled = false: the disabled text roles, and nothing can be chosen or edited.

appearance: Headings are label text in the muted role, numbers code text in the subtle role. The open page has the subtle accent fill with the small radius, a solid accent bar at its start and its title in the strong accent role. In editing, pages are MonarchReorderableList rows on the surface role with a subtle border. Danger menu items use the strong danger role. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web PageTree is a nav with links, a collapse toggle and a footer slot; on Android the selection callback replaces the links (the app navigates), the collapse toggle is left to the app's pane (a list-detail scaffold hides it), and content after the tree replaces the footer. Page and group menus are buttons with Material 3 DropdownMenus, as on the web; iOS uses context menus and swipe actions instead. Monarch bundles no icons, so the add and menu buttons show text unless the app passes addIcon and menuIcon. The web's prompt and confirm dialogs are Material 3 AlertDialogs with MonarchTextField and MonarchTypeToConfirmInput. Pages reorder within a group by drag or the handle's TalkBack actions through MonarchReorderableList, and move between groups only through "Move to", as on the web and iOS. The tree scrolls itself (a verticalScroll column), so it needs a bounded height and cannot sit inside another vertical scroll; each group's reorderable list is bounded so it can sit inside the tree. The parity map named a tree with drag reorder; a two-level grouping reads better as headings and rows, as on iOS. Selection is selected and onSelect, where iOS takes a Binding.
accessibility: The tree is a traversal group named "Pages"; group labels are headings.
Each page is one selectable element read by its title, with the selected state for the open page; page numbers and group counts are not read.
Add and menu buttons are named "Add page to <group>" and "Actions for <name>", whether they show an icon or text.
In editing, each page has a drag handle with Move up and Move down actions for TalkBack and Switch Access, from MonarchReorderableList, which also announces each move.
Moving a page to another group or moving a group is announced through a polite live region ("Welcome moved to Guides.").
Rows and buttons have 48dp touch targets; titles wrap at the largest font scale.
The open page is marked by the accent bar and the selected state as well as by color.
edgeCases: The last page of the document and the only group cannot be deleted: their delete items are not offered.
Deleting a group with pages needs its name typed; an empty group is deleted after a plain confirmation.
Renaming to the same name or to blank text keeps the confirm button disabled.
"Move to" adds the page at the end of the other group.
